title: I LOVE YOU NOW AND ALWAYS

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: It’s so amazing
You’re the God who made the heavens
Great is Your love for me
You load me with mercy in the morning
And goodness at night time
In and out of season
I’m basking in Your grace

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: So, on my lips Your Praise is on repeat
Like an anthem in my soul, Almighty God

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: I love You now and always my eternal King
Your liquid love is overwhelming
It’s indescribable

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: You strike the sweetest love chords
On the strings of my heart
Your demonstrated love’s my victory

slides.label: Verse 7
